```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidypopgen)

# Set cores
n_cores <- 10
data.table::setDTthreads(n_cores)
bigparallelr::set_blas_ncores(n_cores)
```

```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- "../results/s05_fastmixture/"
```

# Load gt

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <-
  gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_clean.gt")
          
  #         ,
  #   reattach_to = "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_clean"
  # )
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% group_by(population)
```

To run a supervised analysis in fastmixture - 'Provide a file of population assignments for individuals as integers in a single column file. Unknown or admixed individuals must be given a value of '0'.'

# Subset to non-malagasy

```{r}
malagasy <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  filter(population %in% c("Betsileo", "Betsimisaraka", "Diego",
      "Merina", "Mikea", "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Temoro", "Vezo"))

bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  filter(!population %in% c("Betsileo", "Betsimisaraka", "Diego",
      "Merina", "Mikea", "Sakalava_Tsimihety", "Temoro", "Vezo"))

gt_as_plink(bor_g1000_sum, file = "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/bor_g1000_sum.bed", overwrite = TRUE)
gt_as_plink(malagasy, file = "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_predict.bed", overwrite = TRUE)
```


```{bash, eval = FALSE}
conda activate /home/EJC199/miniconda3/envs/cfastmixture

# fastmixture in reference dataset
fastmixture --bfile /home/EJC199/Dropbox/gitdata/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/rbind_data/bor_g1000_sum --K 2 --threads 32 --seed 1 --out ref_bor_g1000_sum

# fastmixture using projection mode in new dataset
fastmixture --bfile /home/EJC199/Dropbox/gitdata/malagasy_diversity/data/intermediate/rbind_data/malagasy_predict --K 2 --threads 32 --seed 1 --out malagasy_predicted --projection bor_g1000_sum.K2.s1.P

# Outputs Q file (new.test.K3.s1.Q)

conda deactivate
```



## Supervised



# Add population metadata

```{r}
pop_names <-
  read.csv("../data/raw/data_input/igsr-1000-genomes-phase-3-release.tsv",
    sep = "\t"
  )

# find matching id in pop_names Sample.name and mad_bor_g1000_sum id
# for the matches, replace the population with the population in pop_names
for (i in seq_len(nrow(pop_names))) {
  if (pop_names$Sample.name[i] %in% mad_bor_g1000_sum$id) {
    mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$id == pop_names$Sample.name[i], "population"] <- pop_names$Population.name[i]
  }
}

# replace "Luhya,Luhya" with "Luhya"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Luhya,Luhya"] <- "Luhya"
# replace "Esan,Esan" with "Esan"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Esan,Esan"] <- "Esan"
# replace "Gambian Mandinka,Gambian" with "Gambian Mandinka"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Gambian Mandinka,Gambian"] <- "Gambian Mandinka"
# replace "Mende,Mende" with "Mende"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Mende,Mende"] <- "Mende"
# replace "Kinh,Kinh Vietnamese" with "Kinh Vietnamese"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Kinh,Kinh Vietnamese"] <- "Kinh Vietnamese"
# replcae "Punjabi,Punjabi" with "Punjabi"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Punjabi,Punjabi"] <- "Punjabi"
# replcae "Benga,Bengali" with "Bengali"
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population == "Bengali,Bengali"] <- "Bengali"

# replace any _ with a space
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population <- gsub("_", " ", mad_bor_g1000_sum$population)

mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region <- "Malagasy"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("Borneo", "Sumba", "Timor","Southern Han Chinese", "Kinh Vietnamese","Bengali", "Punjabi"), "Region"] <- "Asia"
mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c("Esan", "Gambian Mandinka", "Luhya", "Mende", "Yoruba"), "Region"] <- "Africa"
```


# Add continent labels

```{r}
obj <- as.factor(mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region)
obj <- as.numeric(obj)
obj[obj == 3] <- 0

write.table(
  file = paste0(res_dir, "data_labels"),
  obj, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE,
  col.names = FALSE
)
```
